text: {"fixes":[{"element_id":"s20","problem":"Chat snippet text is wrong: the real rows show two lines of preview that end with an ellipsis, but the mock shows three lines that wrap differently and clip at the row bottom. This is the largest red area and the cause of the low SSIM (0.653).","fix":"Limit each preview to 2 lines with a 14px font and ~22px line-height, ending in an ellipsis. Use the real text, e.g. 'Miro's breathing hitched. His chest felt tight, like the air in the room was thinning out. The …'. Keep the title at y≈207 and the preview starting at y≈230. Rows are 74px apart."},{"element_id":"s20","problem":"Avatar thumbnails in the header (y≈80-130) and in rows 2-5 are blurry orange blobs rather than the real character art. Only rows 1, 6 and 7 look right.","fix":"Draw the listed pictures at their own rects instead of blurred stand-ins: assets/s20.e96.png at x10.7 y199.6 w59.4 h57.9, assets/s20.e34.art.png at x6.5 y563.1 w71.6 h73.8, assets/s20.e39.art.png at x6.5 y637.4 w71.6 h73.8. For the remaining avatars with no listed picture, use a sharp 16px-radius rounded box with a dark green-brown fill (#2b3a2a). Do not use blur."},{"element_id":"s20","problem":"The bottom bar is blue in the heatmap, so it is masked. The Start new chat button and the pictures at y≈775 sit right there.","fix":"Draw assets/s20.e85.png to e89.png at their rects (y 774.9, 63.6x63.6, x 27.4/100.6/174.1/247.2/320.4) so the bar matches. Keep the 'Start new chat' button text centered at y≈795 with a 1.5px #7c5cbf border."},{"element_id":"s20","problem":"The header text and row text sit about 1px higher than the real screen, and the drag handle is slightly off.","fix":"Shift the header block (Miro | MARSEILLE, the chats pill, the Oldest/Latest toggle) down 1px. Set the handle to y≈50, 44x4px, #5a5d66."},{"element_id":"s03","problem":"The bottom-nav center icon is wrong: the real one is a filled purple spiral/cat-swirl logo, while the mock draws an outlined cat head.","fix":"Replace the center icon with a purple (#a78bfa) spiral logo about 26px, centered at x≈205, y≈805. Match the filled style of the inactive icons at the same size."},{"element_id":"s03","problem":"Text sits 1px higher than the real screen. The header 'My Chats' is at y27 instead of 28, and the row names are 1px high. The titles are also slightly bolder or wider; the 'The Former Husband…' title ends at x≈360 instead of 363.","fix":"Move the header title and the row names down 1px. Use font-weight 500 and 16px for names. Move the right-hand date text from x≈372 to x≈366."},{"element_id":"s05","problem":"The tab indicator is wrong. The real screen has a purple underline under the first tab only (x0-137, y≈213), while the mock's line looks offset. The third tab icon (feather) is also drawn larger and shifted right.","fix":"Underline: 2px #a78bfa at y212-214, x0-137, with a 1px gray divider across the rest. Make the feather icon 18px, centered at x≈341, y≈192."},{"element_id":"s05","problem":"The New Character button is drawn off: the real dashed border is a more visible purple (#7c4dbd) with a 2px stroke and a 14px radius, and the label is 1-2px lower. The hamburger and the stats are slightly offset too.","fix":"Set the border to 1.5px dashed #7c4dbd with radius 14px. Place the label baseline at y≈309 and use a 17px font. Move the stats numbers and the 'View public profile' text down 1px."},{"element_id":"s24","problem":"The text in the form is rendered about 1px off vertically and slightly wider than the real one: the title is at y27 instead of 28, the placeholders are at x41 instead of 40 and are wider, and the warning text is slightly bolder. The text in the Bio hint at the bottom shows in the mock but is cut off in the real screen.","fix":"Shift the title down 1px. Set the placeholder font to 15px, color #7d8088, left padding 18px. Make the warning text weight 600 at 14px. Remove the hint text that appears below the Bio box at y≈830 so it is not visible."}],"summary":"All elements and taps already pass; the remaining loss is in visual fidelity. The worst screen is s20, where the preview text wraps to 3 lines instead of 2 with an ellipsis, and the avatars are blurred. Fix that first, then the s03 center nav icon and 1px text offsets, then the minor s05 and s24 tweaks."}
